name: North Dakota 4-H Ambassador Program
what_you_do: Chosen young leaders for North Dakota 4-H. Ambassadors help plan statewide 4-H events, such as the Extension Youth Conference and retreats. They promote 4-H statewide. They also help at the State Fair and at state or county 4-H events.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 22. The program page does not say if you must be a 4-H member.
pay_detail: Cost not listed on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications were due October 15, 2026, for selection the Saturday before Thanksgiving at the ND 4-H Camp in Washburn. The next chance is the spring election at the Extension Youth Conference in June. The page says those applications are due May 15, but it still lists the June 22 to 25, 2026 conference, so 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Use the Ambassador Resources and Application link. It is on the NDSU Extension leadership page. Send the form to the ND 4-H Center for Youth Development. You must attend all selection day events.
notes: The page does not print a year for the Oct 15 and May 15 deadlines. It lists June 2026 and Feb 2027 events, so Oct 15 was read as 2026. The 2027 spring dates are not posted yet, so the May 15 date is last year's pattern. Questions: ndsu.4hambassadors@ndsu.edu.
